about.title: Built by Nearmelab
about.bio1: I'm Tarik, a developer from Ouarzazate, Morocco creating useful browser tools. Calcatom is my first extension, designed to make calculations fast and accessible while you browse.
about.bio2: Being a solo founder means I'm involved in every step—from initial design to final code. My goal is to create the "indie" alternative to bloated corporate software.

showcase.title: Calcatom - Fast Browser Calculator
showcase.subtitle: The lightweight calculator extension you've been looking for. No trackers, no bloat, just pure utility right in your browser toolbar.

advanced_calculations.title: From Trigonometry to Logarithms.
advanced_calculations.description: Calcatom's scientific mode is packed with features for students and professionals. Handle complex expressions with parentheses, switch between degrees and radians, and utilize a full suite of functions including trig, logs, powers, roots, and factorials. Your entire calculation history is saved, complete with symbolic expressions.

currency_converter.title: Real-time rates for over 150 currencies.
currency_converter.description: Stay up-to-date with our integrated currency converter. Get live exchange rates, including crypto, with a clean and intuitive interface. Swap currencies instantly, search for markets, and manage your favorite currencies for quick access. The UI is designed for speed and clarity, making international conversions effortless.

customization.title: Take control with your own API key.
customization.description: For power users, Calcatom offers the ability to use your own private ExchangeRate-API key. This gives you a higher request limit for currency conversions—1,500 free requests per month. Our settings panel makes it easy to add, validate, and manage your key securely, putting you in control of your data.

why_built.title: "Why I Built This"
why_built.paragraph1: How many times have you been filling out an online form, calculating a budget, or following a recipe, only to be interrupted by the need for a quick calculation?
why_built.paragraph2: I wanted something clean, and respectful of my privacy. So I built Calcatom. I hope you find it as useful as I do.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.content:
We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy outlines how we handle your personal information. If you have any questions, please contact us.

Last Updated: January 23, 2025

1. Data We Don't Collect

We are proud to say that we do not collect, store, or process any of your personal information. Your data is your own. Calcatom performs all its calculations locally on your device. We have no access to your calculations, history, or any other data you enter into the extension.

2. Local Storage

Calcatom uses your browser's local storage (window.localStorage) to save your calculation history and user settings. This data is stored on your own computer and is not transmitted to any server. It is entirely under your control and can be cleared at any time from the extension's settings or by clearing your browser's data.

3. Third-Party Services

We do not use any third-party analytics or tracking services. Our contact form on the support page is a simple Zoho Form, which is only used to transmit your message to our support email. We do not store this information beyond the email communication.

4. Policy Updates

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.

item1.question: How do I access Calcatom?
item1.answer: Once installed, click the puzzle piece icon in your browser toolbar, then click the Calcatom icon. You can also "pin" it for 1-click access.

item2.question: Does it work offline?
item2.answer: Yes, 100%. Calcatom doesn't need an internet connection to perform calculations.

item3.question: How many history items are saved?
item3.answer: Currently, we store the last 50 calculations. You can clear this history at any time in the settings menu.
